note: Admission checks each item's slot and authority.
Schema validation with format checking; timestamps compared at full precision.
Fills slot defaults and versioned route overrides, records defaults_filled, and applies the four slot-level eligibility rules as the complete predicate.
Refuses with required_slot_missing.
Application guards enforce invariants. Nothing observable in assembly can prove it.

Classifies each declared group as instruction or fact and resolves it by authority or route policy; only governing and user items are instruction peers, and trust and the injection marker never change that.
Only governance takes the system and tool roles, the query is the only live user turn, history renders as a transcript, and item bodies are escaped inside wrappers.
Checks producer kind and state age. Writing state stays with the application.
Excludes expired and revoked memory and merges producer exclusions. Reporting them is the producer's duty.
Checks the marker in the five slots that require it, keeps unverified or marked items out of governance, and renders every body whole; delimiting material pasted into a body is the application's job.
Resolves the groups it is given. It cannot detect a conflict the application did not declare.
Refuses with evidence_required and a recovery action.

Gates retrieval producers to the evidence slots, requires the slot's authority and a score wherever the route sets a threshold, and requires that a reported near-duplicate names a candidate the producer kept. It cannot tell whether a producer merged chunks or dropped one silently.
Re-excludes expired or revoked memory as a backstop. Suppressing and reporting them is the producer's duty.
Checks the authenticated emitter and capability grant. The application authenticates, and tool guards enforce calls.
Counts rendered tokens and sheds in tier order.
Refused assemblies have no payload, and their traces carry result: null and no included items. Invalid snapshots are rejected before assembly, with no payload and no trace.
Selects only supplied variants and never calls a model. It cannot verify a variant's fidelity.
Rejects a profile written for another spec, and in deployment mode an unevaluated one. Evaluation itself happens outside assembly.
Pins profile content by hash, rejects a profile that doesn't place a required slot, and refuses the assembly when admitted protected content has no placement.
Traces are checked against the schema and the reason registry, and must match every published case field for field.
Emits source_version, eligibility, excluded slots, snapshot_digest and defaults_filled, and stage timings when the caller lends a clock.
Snapshot replay across processes, hash seeds, time zones and locales, with ordering, blank strings, timestamps and the digest pinned for every language.
Excludes exact duplicate bodies in the slots a route opts in, after conflicts, keeping protected and grouped items.
Keeps only the latest observation per producer and source in the slots a route opts in, after conflicts, keeping protected and grouped items.
Keeps at most max_per_source items per producer and source in the slots a route opts in, after dedupe, keeping protected and grouped items.
